source.review: C1-03 wave 2 — damage spells whose combat effect the existing kinds express: single-target spell attacks and area saving throws with half damage on success. Area spells are authored as multi-target creature selection within the caster's range (the DM picks who is in the area); moving areas, repeat damage on later turns, and choose-at-cast damage types are recorded in each executionScope and not enforced.

definitions.executionScope: Authored (C1-03): a ranged spell attack for 1d8 damage, scaling with character level as a cantrip. The damage type is chosen at cast in the SRD (acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, psychic, thunder); it is authored as fire and the exploding 8 is not enforced.

Authored (C1-03): a ranged spell attack for 3d8, +1d8 per slot level above 1st. The damage type is chosen at cast in the SRD (acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, thunder); it is authored as fire. The leap to a second target on doubles is not enforced.
Authored (C1-03): a ranged spell attack for 4d4 acid, +1d4 per slot level above 2nd. The 2d4 acid at the end of the target's next turn and the half damage on a miss are not enforced.

Authored (C1-03): the cast makes one melee spell attack for 1d8 + spellcasting modifier force damage against a creature within range. Repeating the attack with a bonus action on later turns and +1d8 per two slot levels above 2nd are not enforced.

Authored (C1-03): creatures in the 5-foot-radius cylinder make a CON save for 2d10 radiant, half on success, +1d10 per slot level above 2nd. Moving the beam and the damage on later turns are not enforced; the DM selects who is in the beam.

Authored (C1-03): enemies in the 15-foot emanation make a WIS save for 3d8 radiant (necrotic for evil casters), half on success, +1d8 per slot level above 3rd. The halved speed and the repeat damage when creatures enter or start their turn in the area are not enforced.
Authored (C1-03): creatures in the wall's space when it appears make a STR save for 4d8 bludgeoning, half on success. The wall's effect on ranged attacks, gases and flying creatures is not enforced.

Authored (C1-03): creatures in the 20-foot-radius sphere make a CON save for 5d8 poison, half on success, +1d8 per slot level above 5th. The heavily obscured area, its drift each round and the repeat damage are not enforced.

Authored (C1-03): creatures in the 20-foot-radius sphere make a CON save for 4d10 piercing, half on success, +1d10 per slot level above 5th. The lightly obscured, difficult-terrain area and the repeat damage are not enforced.

Authored (C1-03): creatures in the wall's space when it appears make a DEX save for 6d10 force, half on success. The three-quarters cover, difficult terrain and the repeat damage when creatures enter the wall are not enforced.

Authored (C1-03): creatures in the wall's space when it appears make a DEX save for 5d8 fire, half on success, +1d8 per slot level above 4th. The chosen hot side, the damage within 10 feet of it and the repeat damage are not enforced.

Authored (C1-03): creatures in the wall's space when it appears make a DEX save for 7d8 piercing, half on success, +1d8 per slot level above 6th. The 7d8 slashing for moving through the wall and its blocking of sight are not enforced.

Authored (C1-03): creatures in the wall's space when it appears make a DEX save for 10d6 cold, half on success, +2d6 per slot level above 6th. The wall's hit points, the frigid air after a section breaks (5d6 cold, CON save) and the halved speed are not enforced.

Authored (C1-03): the target makes a DEX save; on a failure it takes 10d6 + 40 force, +3d6 per slot level above 6th; nothing on a success. Disintegration at 0 HP (no revival by Raise Dead and the like) and the object/force-wall destruction are not enforced.

Authored (C1-03): creatures in the wall of water when it appears make a STR save for 6d10 bludgeoning, half on success. The one-minute casting time is recorded; the wall's movement each round, the 5d10 as it passes, and the grappling water are not enforced.

Authored (C1-03): creatures in the 20-foot-radius sphere make a DEX save for 10d8 fire, half on success. The heavily obscured area, its 10-foot drift each round and the repeat damage are not enforced.

Authored (C1-03): creatures in the 20-foot square when it appears make a STR save; on a failure they take 3d6 bludgeoning and are Restrained while the caster concentrates. The difficult terrain, the repeat save and damage each turn, and escaping by a STR or DEX check are not enforced.
